integrity: The proof is included. 54 independent symbolic, numerical and quadrature assertions are reproducible; numerical tests are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Canonical zero-flux radial extension, singular diffusivity D0/rho^2, origin Poisson restarting, fixed alpha in [0,1], stationary population statistics. No noise-stability or non-Poisson memory theorem.
title: A squared-Bessel polynomial arrow of time and three-statistic identification in reset heterogeneous planar diffusion
